directive: FSFFL NEXT Forecast Source-Coordinate & Extrapolation Audit Directive
label: COORDINATE_MISMATCH_IDENTIFIED
conclusion: Historical P0 source_points and current governed 2026 Y1 fantasy_points are not semantically equivalent in a material way. P0 was trained on frozen standard/non-PPR fantasy points, while the current 2026 Y1 source coordinate is connected-league half-PPR. The Outcome-B current materializer passed the half-PPR Y1 value directly into P0 as source_points.

decisive_evidence.historical_contract: Frozen I1 research coordinate is standard/non-PPR. Reception coefficient is 0.
decisive_evidence.current_contract: Governed current Year-1 uses management 12-team half-PPR scoring. Reception coefficient is 0.5.
decisive_evidence.governed_cross_check: The position ratios mechanically reconstructed from current raw projection receptions exactly match the already-governed future-I1 position scoring multipliers stored in the current Year-1 universe.
decisive_evidence.direct_materialization_error: The frozen current-board materializer assigns league-scored y1_points to source_points without first returning the input to the historical standard-scoring coordinate.

secondary_semantic_differences: Historical source points are realized season totals and embed missed games/partial seasons; current Y1 is a forward-looking full-season projection coordinate.

Historical source panel is a broad realized player-season population including zero/negative and low-games seasons; current board is a 335-player projection-covered subset that fails closed on undercovered projection rows.
Historical seasons 1999-2025 are not era/schedule-normalized; current Y1 is a 2026 full-season projection.

accounting_only_known_board.warning: Not a corrected forecast because P0 was also fed the half-PPR source_points.

stage_gates.reason: The directive conditions Stage 2 on semantic comparability. Formal support/extrapolation analysis on mixed standard and half-PPR source coordinates would be invalid.

descriptive_nonclassification_note.interpretation: This suggests a support/availability question may remain after the coordinate is corrected, but it is not classified as Outcome B in this audit because the prerequisite semantic-equivalence gate failed.

smallest_governed_correction: From the already-governed raw 2026 FFToday/Razzball stat ensemble, freeze a second Year-1 source coordinate scored under the existing FROZEN_I1_STANDARD_SCORING rules.
Use that standard-scored coordinate as P0 source_points and as the current side of historical/current production-calibration comparisons.
Keep the connected-league half-PPR Year-1 board as a separate league/presentation coordinate.
Do not compare or ratio standard-trained P0 future point quantities directly against half-PPR Year-1 points.

Before any further Forecast repair, explicitly govern how future P0 point outputs are converted to league half-PPR units, then rerun this audit from Stage 1 and proceed to Stage 2 only if semantic comparability passes.
named_examples_status: Explanation-only table persisted. Named players were not used to choose any correction.
